name: Always Dental Care
description: A Phoenixville general dentistry practice offering routine checkups, cleanings, and restorative care.

hero.headline: Always Dental Care
hero.sub: Routine care, restorative work, and a straightforward approach to every visit.

items: Restorative dentistry including fillings and crowns
Preventive guidance to keep future visits simple
New patients welcome, most insurance accepted
Modern equipment and a comfort-first exam room
Clear treatment plans explained before any work begins

story.heading: About
paragraphs: Always Dental Care keeps the basics right: prevention first, clear communication, and a team that explains each step.
The goal is a practice patients actually want to return to for their next checkup.

items: Book an appointment and get a straightforward explanation of what a visit involves.
No surprise upsells -- treatment plans are reviewed with you before anything is scheduled.
A calm, modern office designed to take the edge off a dental visit.

feature.heading: Preventive care that catches problems early
feature.text: Regular cleanings and exams cost less than emergency work down the road -- and hurt a lot less too.

spotlight.heading: Restorative work, done plainly
spotlight.text: From a simple filling to a crown, treatment is scoped to what you actually need -- nothing more.
